text:
deploybot: tag created: `release-2026-03-20_2045` (commit `9f1b2c4`). Snapshot pushed to staging. Changelog (high level):
- scheduling: reduce tail latency for continuous batching
- fix: kv-cache leak for >64k token sessions
- fix: emoji/tokenizer edge-case for multibyte sequences
Env: staging. Planned canary: prod-canary -> 10% traffic, 30m. Rollout window: 04:10-06:10 UTC. Promote command: `redwood deploy promote release-2026-03-20_2045 --to prod-canary`. changelog: <https://internal.redwood.ai/releases/release-2026-03-20_2045|release notes>. :rocket:

meera: QA ✅ on staging (smoke + regression). Noted a ~4% p95 regression on long-context perf (investigating). No correctness regressions in the prompt testset.

alex: can we delay canary by 30m? infra maintenance window overlaps at 04:00 UTC.

jordan: agree with alex, prefer starting canary at 04:40 UTC and keep 10% for 45m. Also recommend limiting to dedicated pools (no shared burst) for first rollout. :thumbsup:

meera: ok to start 04:40 UTC. We'll set canary to dedicated pool and monitor traces + token-level cost. If perf regression >6% revert.

sam: note for ops: rollback procedure if canary fails:
```
# pin older stable
redwood deploy pin service=inference image=release-2026-02-28_stable
# rollback tag
redwood deploy promote release-2026-02-28_stable --to prod
```
Also ensure alerts are on for p95 > baseline + 5% and error rate spike >0.5%. :warning:

meera: running a quick perf micro-benchmark now, will post numbers in 10m. If everything holds we'll merge canary schedule and add manual approval gate before full prod rollout.

deploybot: canary schedule saved: start=2045007040 (04:40 UTC), duration=45m, target=prod-canary(10%), pools=[dedicated-inference]. Approval required: @meera or @sam to approve full rollout.

alex: approved for canary start 04:40 UTC. I'll be on watch for infra window.

jordan: adding a short note to the release channel and docs about the kv-cache fix since it affects long sessions.

meera: perf micro-bench: +2.3% p95 vs baseline on 64k tokens (within threshold). moving ahead with canary at 04:40 UTC. I'll abort and pin if p95 goes >6% or errors spike.

sam: I'll prepare rollback image and have on-call standby. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
